intro_note: Written after the examiner panel converged. This practice model keeps your four-part information sequence while strengthening comparisons and sentence control. Figures are approximate.

spans.text: The line graph compares
the numbers of armed robberies, assaults and murders

highlight.label: Count incidents
highlight.explanation: Plural event nouns identify the three separate series clearly.

spans.text: recorded in London between 2003 and 2012.
Overall, armed robbery fell substantially,
whereas assault increased and became the most common of the three crimes

highlight.label: Compare directions and rankings
highlight.explanation: The overview reports both the contrasting trend and the changed ranking.

spans.text: . Murder remained the least common category throughout,
despite some fluctuations

highlight.label: Qualify the overview
highlight.explanation: The lowest ranking remained constant, but the murder figures were not flat.

spans.text: Armed robbery started at approximately 3,400 cases in 2003 and
peaked at around 3,700 the following year

highlight.label: Peak and approximation
highlight.explanation: Use peaked at for the highest numerical level and around for an estimated graph reading.

spans.text: . The figure then dropped sharply to just over 1,000 in 2008.
After recovering to about 1,500 in 2009, it remained close to this level until 2012.

highlight.label: Connect related movements
highlight.explanation: Combine recovery and subsequent stability; it and this level have clear antecedents.

spans.text: This was
less than half the initial figure

highlight.label: Compare the endpoints
highlight.explanation: This concise comparison shows the scale of the overall decline.

spans.text: Assault cases numbered roughly 2,300 in 2003 and fluctuated before reaching about 2,000 in 2008. They
had overtaken armed robbery by 2007

highlight.label: Report the crossover
highlight.explanation: By 2007 gives the changed annual ranking without inventing an exact crossing date.

spans.text: . The figure subsequently
rose overall, reaching approximately 2,800 in 2012 despite a small dip in 2011

highlight.label: Attach the participle clearly
highlight.explanation: The figure is the subject of rose and reaching; overall and despite preserve the intervening dip.

spans.text: . Meanwhile, murder cases
fluctuated between roughly 500 and 900, peaking in 2005

highlight.label: Range and turning point
highlight.explanation: Fluctuated between reports the range; peaking identifies the highest year rather than claiming stability throughout.

spans.text: before ending the period at about 500, similar to their starting level.
